generationInputs.prompt: A realistic CD jewel case, centered against a light gray background, showcases the cover art for a fictional album. The album insert features minimalist, retro-style vector artwork with flat colors and bold outlines, reflecting a playful mood with bright primary colors, chunky figures, and whimsical motifs. The central image is a stylized, polished, clear diamond with brilliant facets, around which white smoke or vapor swirls on the left, partially obscuring it. To the right of the diamond, a peach, an eggplant, and a clear plastic syringe with a light blue tip are positioned vertically. The syringe, rendered in simplified graphic form, contains a clear liquid with black measurement markings, and its thin metallic needle points upwards. The bold album title "Diamond & Dusk" is in a wide, rounded typeface, with "late night loops" as a subtitle. A fictional label name and logo, "NEON FOIL RECORDS," are in one corner. The composition is polished and editorial, like a conceptual product photo.
